Create a fake support ticket base

Source: R/fake_web.R
fake_visits.Rd

Create a fake support ticket base

Usage

fake_visits(
  from = "2017-01-01",
  to = "2017-12-31",
  local = c("en_US", "fr_FR"),
  seed = 2811
)

Arguments

from, to

the date to cover

local

the local of the base. Currently supported : "fr_FR" and "en_US".

seed

fixe la graine aleatoire

Value

A dataframe of fake web visits.

Examples

fake_visits()
